propositions: LLM provider errors (Bedrock ValidationException) during epic-close bug screen calls are degraded to verdict C ('unrelated') instead of propagating, silently blinding the caused_by bug floor check when the provider fails systematically

The per-candidate degrade-open behavior masks aggregate provider outages: when all 32 candidate screen calls fail due to provider unavailability, the gate reports PASS with no aggregate signal that screening never occurred
max_tokens is never re-clamped when model selection shrinks from 128K to 64K ceiling, causing Bedrock ValidationException 400 on every screen call
Absent-provider path correctly fails closed (refusing close), but present-but-failing-provider path fails open (degrading to PASS), creating asymmetric failure modes for the same dependency
LLMUnavailableError (including subclass LLMConfigError) must be re-raised at both screen layers instead of caught by broad except-Exception handlers to propagate to close gate's fail-closed handler
